cornell.role: Measured geometry and spectral reflectance; relative light spectrum
cornell.geometryUnits: millimetres, converted to metres without idealizing the geometry
cornell.cameraUnits: Position in millimetres; focal length and sensor dimensions in metres
cornell.normalization: Published relative emission spectrum unchanged; no per-image exposure fitting. 450, 550 and 650 nm simulations remain monochromatic, not an RGB reconstruction.
cornell.license: The source offers the data for public use. No SPDX redistribution license established; retain bulk downloads in ignored local research artifacts and preserve attribution.
cornell.pairedMeasurementEligibility: Unverified: downloaded camera photos appear to contain a reflective tall block and a different camera framing from the published diffuse-scene table. Camera response/filter/lens spectra are available, but these are not sufficient to infer missing material/camera identities. Do not score these as paired images.

cie171.source: Dau Design & Consulting, Report on AGi32 validation of CIE 171:2006, June 20 2007; section 5.2, Table 7, printed page 18 (PDF page 18).
cie171.implemented: 5.2 on-axis A only: I=1000 cd, d=3 m, incidence 0 degrees, E=1000/9 lx. Uses an isotropic source sharing the reported on-axis intensity. Other photometries and off-axis points are not reproduced.
cie171.errata: No authoritative complete errata set was established from accessible sources. The public implementation report discusses reference discrepancies in other cases; those cases are omitted. No complete conformity or certification claim.
cie171.omitted: All other 5.2 points/photometries and the remaining analytical/experimental CIE cases; full normative definitions and conditions not reproduced. No paid source required for this subset.

analyticAuthority.lambert: L = rho E cos(theta) / pi; E is specified on a plane normal to the beam
analyticAuthority.point: E(x,y) = I h / (x*x+y*y+h*h)^(3/2); fixed isotropic radiant-intensity scale
analyticAuthority.environment: Uniform radiance Lenv gives diffuse outgoing radiance rho Lenv
analyticAuthority.visibility: Integrate cosine-weighted visibility over a uniform solid-angle disc independently of either renderer; a black half-plane gives a known straight shadow boundary
analyticAuthority.spectralUnits: Analytical fixtures use independent scalar/RGB transport. The CIE axis verifies the geometric factor E/I, not an undocumented conversion of RGB watts into photometric lux.
